decisions.reason: Because A stayed visible for at least two years, is close to the core portfolio, and likely supports broader system sales in an expanding firm with some slack, it probably meets or is near aspiration and will be retained.

C appears less prominently than A but remained offered beyond launch and fits the firm's modular formwork business, so management is more likely to keep it as a complementary product unless performance clearly falls short.
E had its own product page across the observed years and is closely related to the established offer, which suggests acceptable results and a good strategic fit that favor continuation.

F looks more marginal because it was only mentioned on the website, but since similar weak products were dropped earlier while F was not, it likely cleared the minimum aspiration and is somewhat more likely to be kept than removed.
